summary: Small rectangular carrier PCB for a 3-axis gyro. It has two round mounting holes on one short end of the long edge, a row of 9 header pads along one long edge, and a few surface-mount components and a square chip on the top face.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat underside of the board, which can sit on standoffs through the two 0.086 in holes
Top face carrying the components, with the 9-pad 0.1 in pitch pin row along one long edge

notes: X and Y come from the printed 0.5 in x 0.9 in outline (12.7 x 22.86 mm). The hole diameter comes from the printed 0.086 in (2.18 mm). Hole positions are estimated from pixel measurements in the dimensioned image and are centered on the board. Z = 3 mm is the unverified catalog height, since no thickness is printed. The bounding box is centered at the origin. The 9 header holes at 0.1 in (2.54 mm) pitch lie along one long edge, but their diameter is not stated, so they are left out of the holes list.
